text:
Marcus: Heads up — renewal for Nimbus Corp due 2026-04-05. Procurement sent a signed PO but it's under legacy billing entity 'Nimbus Holdings LLC' while our SOW uses 'Nimbus Cloud Inc'. They want to keep the agreed pricing. Can we amend or do a re-exec? cc @Liz @Priya
Priya: Do we have a corrected PO yet? Procurement says they won't issue a new PO until legal confirms amendment language.
Marcus: I have the PDF they sent — link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0x9f4 (attaching). They specifically called out preserving the 12% discount we committed. If amendment is possible, we need to confirm authorized signer for the new entity.
Liz: We can do a short amendment (entity swap + updated signature block). Need customer to confirm authorized signer for 'Nimbus Cloud Inc' and provide EIN. Also will check VAT/tax impacts. I can draft — ETA EOD today.
Tom: Finance note: if amended, we need the new Tax ID (EIN) and billing contact so we can update vendor record. Also include PO# on the amendment header.
Marcus: Procurement is asking about effective date — they want coverage retro to the renewal date. Any blockers?
Liz: We can't backdate revenue recognition. Amendment can state "effective upon execution"; invoice/proration will follow actual service start. I'll add explicit language so there's no confusion.
Priya: Customer preference: minimal friction. They'd prefer a DocuSign amendment rather than full re-exec. However the signer on the envelope is no longer authorized for the new entity.
Marcus: Procurement mentioned they could provide a board resolution or officer attestation. I'll request that now.
DocuSignBot: Envelope 0x9f4 sent to mari.k@nimbus.com — viewed at 1748024000.
Tom: When amendment is ready, please cc finance@redwood so we can update vendor, billing email, and tax details. Also confirm PO# 88912 to be referenced.
Liz: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/nimbus-entity-amend.pdf. Key points: entity swap, preserve pricing/term, signature block for "Nimbus Cloud Inc", effective on signing, clause preserving previous discounts. Priya — can you review quickly?
Priya: LGTM, a couple tiny wording nits but nothing material. Send to customer and include a short note requesting the EIN and the authorized signer evidence (board resolution or officer letter).
Marcus: :thumbsup: Sounds good. I'll update the renewal tracker and mark as 'Awaiting Customer Sign'. If procurement sends the corrected PO first, we'll attach as Exhibit A to the amendment.
Tom: Finance has no objections. Please ensure we get the EIN and billing contact before invoicing.
Liz: Will send for signature once customer confirms signer. I'll also add the preservation clause so pricing isn't reopened.
Marcus: Thanks team — keeping this one high priority, will update here with any docs from customer.
